l.i: virium, spondeo vobis tamen in fungendo hoc
fratres, ut ad ultimum illud orationis
à vobis ego vicissim expecto, vel saltem
expeto ; compluria illa quidem, si aut
mihi vacaret exequi, aut vobis audire
singula. Sed præterquam quod id ni-
mis longum esset, est quoque ut mihi
omnia illa unâ voce complexum esse
molis, non cum uno jam Typhone Ro-
& pene singularis in hac arena concer-

page.notes: The ligatures "ct" in "expecto" and "ss" in "vicissim" are read as the usual letters. The "expecto" in the first instance is a doubtful reading of a ct ligature. The bracket after "Romano" is printed as "(" joined to "quæ", probably a typographic mark, and is kept as printed. Long s is rendered as s throughout. Fragments of the neighbouring page at the right edge are not transcribed.
